basic_details.job_title: Goa PSC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 40 Senior Technical Examiner & Other Posts
basic_details.post_name: Senior Technical Examiner, Technical Examiner, Assistant Professor, Biochemist, Associate Professor, Tutor and other posts

application_fee.details: The notification does not specify the exact application fee amount, but states that candidates must pay application fees either online (via online payment and e-receipt download) or offline (via e-challan cash payment at any SBI Branch situated in Goa).

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is not exceeding 45 years for Assistant Professor, Biochemist, Associate Professor, and Tutor posts. The official notification does not specify an upper age limit for Senior Technical Examiner and Technical Examiner posts by transfer on deputation.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | senior technical examiner (directorate of vigilance): Officers under the Central/State/Union Territory Government: (i) holding analogous post on regular basis; or (ii) in L-11 of the pay matrix with five years regular service in the grade, possessing educational qualifications prescribed for direct recruits i.e., Degree in Civil Engineering or Construction Engineering, from a recognized University. | technical examiner (directorate of vigilance): Officers under the Central/State/Union Territory Government: (i) holding analogous post on regular basis; or (ii) in L-10 of the pay matrix with three years regular service in the grade or in L-8 of the pay matrix five years regular service in the grade or in L-7 of the pay matrix with eight years regular service in the grade, possessing educational qualifications prescribed for direct recruits i.e., Degree in Civil Engineering or Construction Engineering, from a recognized University. | assistant professor (medical gastroenterology / surgical gastroenterology / cardiac anaesthesiology): i) A recognized medical qualification included in the First or the Second Schedule or Part II of the Third Schedule (other than Licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956. (ii) Post graduate degree or equivalent qualification in the speciality concerned from a National Medical Commission (then Medical Council of India) recognized medical college/institution. (iii) At least one year teaching or research experience in a recognized Medical College/Teaching Institution in the subject of super-speciality after obtaining the qualifying degree of Doctorate of Medicine (D.M.)/Master of Chirurgiae (M.Ch.). (Note: For candidate with D.M./M.Ch. degree of three years duration, no experience is required after qualifying degree). (iv) Knowledge of Konkani. | assistant professor in physical medicine and rehabilitation: i) A recognized medical qualification included in the First or the Second Schedule or Part II of the Third Schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956. (ii) Post graduate degree or equivalent qualification in the speciality concerned from a recognized medical college/institution. (iii) At least three years experience in the concerned speciality as a lecturer or in an equivalent teaching post in a Medical College/Teaching Institution after the requisite post graduate degree. (iv) Knowledge of Konkani. | biochemist: (i) M.Sc in Bio-chemistry as a principal subject of a recognised University. (ii) Knowledge of Konkani. | associate professor (medical surgical nursing / midwifery and obstetrical nursing): i) Master’s Degree in Nursing in concerned speciality i.e., Medical Surgical Nursing/Paediatrics/Obstetrics/Community Health Nursing/Psychiatry, with at least 55% marks or equivalent. ii) Minimum ten years teaching experience in a recognized College of Nursing after Master Degree in Nursing, failing which, minimum five years teaching experience in a recognized College of Nursing with an aggregate of 10 years of teaching experience in a recognized school and College of Nursing. iii) Knowledge of Konkani. | tutor: (i) Master’s Degree in Nursing from a recognized University and if a candidate with Master’s degree in nursing is not available, Bachelor of Science in Nursing/Post Basic Bachelor of Science in Nursing from a recognized University, with three years of experience, out of which, one year should be teaching experience in School/College of Nursing. (ii) Knowledge of Konkani.

Download your completed application form only after successful payment.

faq.question: Q1. What is Goa PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Goa PSC Recruitment 2026 is an employment notification released by the Goa Public Service Commission for filling 40 vacancies across various departments such as the Directorate of Vigilance, Goa Medical College, and Directorate of Health Services.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in Goa PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 40 vacancies have been advertised under advertisement number 10 YEAR 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Goa PSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to fill up online applications for all posts other than transfer on deputation is 23 October 2026. For transfer on deputation posts only, the last date is 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential qualifications required for Goa PSC posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post, ranging from degrees in Civil Engineering for technical posts, specialized medical degrees (D.M./M.Ch./Postgraduate medical qualifications) for Assistant Professors, M.Sc. in Biochemistry for Biochemist, to Master's or Bachelor's degrees in Nursing for nursing posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Goa PSC posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not exceeding 45 years for Assistant Professor, Biochemist, Associate Professor, and Tutor posts. The age limit for deputation posts is not specified in the notification.
